_comment: Decidr Weekly Marketing Report — Week 29 (13–19 Jul 2026). HubSpot funnel/product/channel/SQL pulled live 2026-07-20. Meta/LinkedIn spend from Supermetrics (AUD); Google pending (token expired). Geography omitted (country property now permission-restricted). Website/GA4 + creatives placeholder.

highlight.html: Headline SQLs are inflated by a Partnerships bulk import — but underneath, the State of AI event is converting. 179 new contacts (60 subscribers + 119 qualified). The funnel shows 41 SQL+, but 30 of those are a one-off Partnerships qualification via Offline import, not organic marketing — strip it out and marketing SQL+ ≈ 11. The real story: the "State of AI in Australian Businesses" launch event (Facebook), which produced 0 MQL last week, matured into 12 MQL+ and 2 DecidrOS SQLs (Jess Browne · Biz Elevation, Varusha Chetty · Impact vibe). LinkedIn's State of AI campaign added 3 MQL — its best of the series. DecidrOS drove 51 new leads and 19 MQL+. The AI Roadmap demo has nearly dried up (1 lead). All 6 opportunities were sales-created (incl. KPMG UK, CORE Markets).

observations.html: Headline SQLs are inflated by a bulk import. 30 of the 41 SQL+ are Partnerships contacts qualified via a one-off Offline import/list — not organic marketing. Judge the week on the ~11 marketing-driven SQL+ (DecidrOS 3, Unassigned 8 incl. 6 sales-created opps).

The State of AI launch event is now converting. After 0 MQL in Week 28, the Facebook State of AI event produced 53 contacts, 12 MQL+ and 2 DecidrOS SQLs (Jess Browne · Biz Elevation, Varusha Chetty · Impact vibe) — the delayed payoff from the launch.
LinkedIn's best MQL week. The LinkedIn State of AI campaign ($2,743) produced 3 MQL — LinkedIn's first real qualified flow in the series. Worth watching whether it sustains before scaling.

AI Roadmap has dried up. Just 1 lead this week (from 9 in Week 26, 3 in Week 28) for $1,118 — the audience is exhausted. Refresh creative/targeting or reallocate to the State of AI event, now the stronger performer.
DecidrOS volume up sharply. 51 new DecidrOS leads and 19 MQL+ this week — the State of AI event is feeding the DecidrOS funnel, a clear step up from prior weeks.

All 6 opportunities were sales-created. KPMG UK, CORE Markets and 4 others entered via CRM / forward / BCC — strong logos, but not marketing-attributed. Tag source/product for clean pipeline reporting.

Paid media ≥ $9,995 (Google pending). Meta $6,552, LinkedIn $3,443; Google Ads spend unavailable — the Supermetrics Google connection token expired mid-pull and needs reconnecting (prior weeks ~$446).
